body:
deploybot: Starting deploy to prod: service=redwood-inference-api image=redwood/api:v2026.03.12 sha=ab12c4f link=https://deploys.internal/redwood/12345 change-window=18:00-19:00 UTC

samir.kapoor: Noted. Can we confirm rollback pin procedure before we ramp canary? want the exact commands in thread.

meera.patel: +1. Also adding thresholds: if 5xx > 3% for 3m OR p95 latency increases by >150ms for 5m we back out. Put it in the runbook.

jen: I updated the playbook — link: https://confluence.internal/redwood/runbooks/deploy-backout. Key steps:
- pin traffic to previous tag
- redeploy old replicas to dedicated pool
- invalidate cache if model schema changed

ryan_ops: Copying the quick commands here for oncall:```
# pin traffic to previous release
redwoodctl traffic set redwood-inference-api --version=ab12b3d --weight=100

# force-deploy previous image
redwoodctl deploy create --service redwood-inference-api --image redwood/api:v2026.03.11 --force
```

samir.kapoor: thanks. Two clarifications: 1) Does config flip require DB migration rollback? 2) If canary shows errors, do we immediately pin or run a partial rollback?

jen: 1) No DB rollback expected for this release (no schema changes). 2) Policy: immediate pin to previous version if error threshold hit during canary or early ramp. If it's subtle (lower SLO regression) we can pause and reduce traffic to 10% while we triage for up to 20 minutes.

meera.patel: Ops checklist for oncall to run if we back out:
- run `redwoodctl logs --since 10m --service redwood-inference-api` and paste in incident channel
- revert routing via redwoodctl traffic set (ryan commands above)
- validate downstream consumers (webhook queue length, async worker lag)
- run smoke tests: `curl -sS https://api.redwood.ai/health | jq .`

deploybot: Canary rollout: 1% -> 10% (10m) -> 50% (20m) -> 100% (10m). Manual hold at each step. Auto-abort configured for 5xx > 3% sustained 3m.

samir.kapoor: I'll be watching errors and latency. If we abort, I'll coordinate with eng-releases to cut a hotfix branch.

ryan_ops: I'm going to pre-stage the previous image on all pools so pin is <2m. Running prefetch now.

jen: reminder: pin criteria for release notes and change log: we add the rollback reason and the exact sha we pinned to. We also create a short incident note if we aborted.

meera.patel: Good. Final preflight items: monitoring alerts live and dashboards linked in the runbook, oncall has deploy perms, and riot channel #incidents is notified.

samir.kapoor: ok let's start canary at 18:02 UTC. I'll post updates. :thumbsup:

deploybot: Canary started: 1% traffic -> image=redwood/api:v2026.03.12. ETA to 10% step 18:12 UTC.

samir.kapoor: spotting a small uptick in 4xx from auth service, investigating (not yet 5xx).

meera.patel: keep an eye, if it spikes to 5xx >3% escalate to oncall.

ryan_ops: prefetch complete: previous image ab12b3d available in all pools. pin command tested in staging.

samir.kapoor: holding at 1% for a few more minutes while auth team checks. If auth clears we continue, else we pin and abort.

jen: adding a short note to the release page: "holding at canary due to upstream auth noise"

samir.kapoor: auth fixed, continuing to 10%.

deploybot: Traffic moved to 10% at 18:14 UTC.

meera.patel: monitoring looks stable. continuing.

samir.kapoor: 10% -> 50% in 20m unless we see regression.

(20 minutes pass)

deploybot: Traffic moved to 50% at 18:34 UTC.

samir.kapoor: p95+120ms relative to baseline, error rate still <1%. I'll keep watching for 10m.

meera.patel: if p95 stays >+150ms for 5m we abort. Currently borderline but under threshold.

ryan_ops: if we need to pin, remember this quick revert: `redwoodctl traffic set redwood-inference-api --version=ab12b3d --weight=100` — will take ~90s.

samir.kapoor: 50% stable for 8m, continuing to 100%.

deploybot: Final ramp to 100% at 18:46 UTC. Deployment complete.

samir.kapoor: No abort. Postmortem: none required. tagging release notes and closing runbook checklist. :tada:
